issue_context.title: Include commit summary in git blame hints
issue_context.body: ### Check for existing issues - [X] Completed ### Describe the feature The git inline hints are super useful, but I often find myself having to hover over the hint to get more context on what the change was. The feature request is to include the commit message (at least the first line) in the editor itself. This is similar to #10771, but only affects the inline view. Open for debate if we want to make this a setting or template-able instead. ### If applicable, add mockups / screenshots to help present your vision of the feature

review_comments: I'm new in rust, but is it OK `false_value` function returns a `true` value? 🤔
Hehe, good catch. That was fixed in a follow-up PR: https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19943
Also, serde's default for `bool` is `false` so it could've been just `#[serde(default)]` without any extra functions.
